# GlyphCompress

> Semantic compression for IDE↔LLM communication. A CLI, VS Code extension, MCP server, and Node.js library that compresses verbose IDE→LLM context (code, diagnostics, chat history, diffs) into compact Unicode glyph sequences, using a shared codebook injected into the model's system prompt so the model can decode it back. Reversible by default, calibrated against real provider tokenizers (js-tiktoken for OpenAI, live API measurement for Anthropic/Gemini), and gated by a net-negative fallback that never knowingly sends output more expensive than the original.

Dual-licensed: AGPL-3.0-only for open-source use, commercial license required for proprietary/SaaS/embedded use (see COMMERCIAL_LICENSE.md). npm package `glyph-compress`; VS Code Marketplace extension `neolambo.glyph-compress`; GitHub repo `Neolambo/glyph-compress`.

## Entry points (for an agent integrating this library)

- CLI: `npx glyph-compress <file> [--level ...] [--provider ...] [--copy] [--explain] [--source-map]` — see `bin/cli.js`.
- MCP server: `npx glyph-compress-mcp` exposes `compress_text`, `compress_file`, `route_context`, `get_codebook` tools — see `bin/mcp-server.js`.
- Node.js library: `import { GlyphCompressor } from 'glyph-compress/middleware'` — see `src/glyph-middleware.js` and `src/index.d.ts` for the typed public API.
- Token estimation: `src/token-estimator.js` exports `estimateProviderTokens`, `PROVIDER_TOKEN_PROFILES`, `estimateGlyphTokenCost` for real, calibrated per-provider token math.
